# The first mutation run fails and prints nothing. The fix lane gets one finding with the exit code, and the head gets no full review before the fix.
exec beehest run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star
stdout 'item 7 finished'

grep -count=2 '^build mutation sh mutation.sh origin/integration$' mutation.log
grep -count=2 '^fix 1 ' calls.log
! grep '^fix 2 ' calls.log
grep -count=3 '^review ' calls.log
# The first fix takes the hit of the implementer and is clean, so the exit code is the first finding of the second fix. Both are fix round 1.
grep -count=1 '^found=The mutation command exited with code 1 and printed no finding.' findings.log

-- mutations --
sh mutation.sh origin/integration => silent
sh mutation.sh origin/integration => clean
-- verdicts --
approve
approve
approve
